create_InputDataset: create an InputDataset from DataparserOutputs with a configurable scale factor for image resolution
get_numpy_image: get a numpy uint8 image array from the dataset by its image index
get_image_float32: get a float32 torch tensor image normalized to 0-1 range by image index
get_data: get a dictionary containing the image, mask, and metadata for a given image index
get_image_uint8: get a uint8 torch tensor image with alpha compositing applied by image index
